schema:
CREATE TABLE Crime (
  arrest,
  beat,
  block,
  case_number,
  community_area_no,
  date,
  district_no,
  domestic,
  fbi_code_no,
  iucr_no,
  latitude,
  location_description,
  longitude,
  report_no,
  ward_no
);

CREATE TABLE District (
  address,
  commander,
  district_name,
  district_no,
  email,
  fax,
  phone,
  tty,
  twitter,
  zip_code
);

CREATE TABLE Ward (
  Population,
  alderman_first_name,
  alderman_last_name,
  alderman_name_suffix,
  city_hall_office_fax,
  city_hall_office_phone,
  city_hall_office_room,
  ward_email,
  ward_no,
  ward_office_address,
  ward_office_fax,
  ward_office_phone,
  ward_office_zip
);
